heroHeadline: Ayotzinapa Investigation Stalls as Families Demand Answers After 11 Years
heroSubtitle: Five months without a meeting with President Sheinbaum. The court-ordered Truth Commission (COVAJ) is non-functional. Military intelligence files remain undelivered. Families gathered for a National Popular Assembly on May 9 to define escalation strategy — as only 3 of 43 students have ever been identified.
footerNote: Data compiled from GIEI reports (I–VI), Mexican Truth Commission, EAAF forensic reports, IACHR/OHCHR statements, and investigative journalism (Proceso, Animal Político, La Jornada, Tlachinollan). All contested claims are marked.
